content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for GMSH Chandigarh Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Government Multi Speciality Hospital Chandigarh (GMSH Chandigarh) for filling up specialist medical positions on a contract basis in Chandigarh.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under GMSH Chandigarh Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 10 vacancies available for various specialist posts including Paediatrician, Surgery, Orthopaedics, Medicine, ENT, and Psychiatrist.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode for GMSH Chandigarh recruitment is strictly Walk-in. Eligible candidates need to attend the interview directly on the specified date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the date of the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 01 October 2026. Candidates must complete their registration between 9.30 am and 10.30 am on the same day.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS Degree with MD/DNB/MS/Diploma in the respective specialty from a Recognized University and must be registered with the State Medical Council or MCI/NMC.

faq.question: Q6. What is the upper age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the advertised specialist posts is 62 years. Please check the official notification for any applicable age relaxation guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: Selected specialist candidates will receive a remuneration of Rs. 2,000/- per slot of two hours per day as per the hospital guidelines.

faq.question: Q8. Do I need to pay any application fee?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified in the official notification for attending the walk-in interview or applying for these contract posts.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring their bio-data on the prescribed application format, self-attested copies of certificates from matriculation onwards, one recent passport-size photograph, and all original documents for verification.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for selected candidates?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will be posted at Government Multi Speciality Hospital (GMSH), located in Chandigarh, with a pincode of 160015.
